evals.prompt: I have a first meeting with a regional bank about AI but no discovery notes yet. Help me choose a demo direction.
evals.expected_output: {slug}-ideation.md produced with a clear archetype, target audience assumptions, proposed wow moments, data strategy, and explicit open questions.
assertions: Does not invent confirmed discovery facts
Selects a demo archetype and explains why
Identifies at least 3 open discovery questions
Provides a frozen direction contract usable by weave-script
Marks assumptions clearly so later discovery can validate or replace them

evals.prompt: We have a manufacturing prospect with vague interest in operational AI. No notes yet. Run ideation only.
evals.expected_output: Ideation output frames an operational use case without running discovery parser, platform audit, or build stages.
assertions: Runs as Mode 3 (scratch) ideation — no qualification gate because there is no discovery
Does not proceed to platform audit or script generation
Creates a practical data strategy for synthetic or representative data
Includes wow moments and qualification questions for the first discovery call

evals.prompt: acme-pharma is qualified (proceed). Run ideation from the demo-goals brief; I also want to add Agent Builder for a conversational investigation scene.
evals.expected_output: Mode 1 ideation. capability-map.json built via loom_state vision map add with catalog ids (vision origin) plus agent-builder as sa_added; ai-cost-dashboard implied per D-036; frozen with loom_state vision freeze; refreshed confirmation + summary TL;DR Demo direction line; loom_state vision confirm after SA approval.
assertions: Runs loom_state vision plan first and respects the gate
Contract H1 uses the public display name and slug — never the real company name
Capability Map table has an Origin column; agent-builder is SA added
ai-cost-dashboard appears as implied (D-036) and Operational Transparency is yes
Out of Scope and Minimum Bar sections are present
Build Effort is presented as an estimate, not the Demo path decision
Confirmation refresh has What We'll Show You and How We Define a Successful Evaluation without internal pipeline terms
Runs loom_state vision confirm only after explicit SA approval
